snippet.title: Shade of the Marionette | Official First Trailer
snippet.description:
Shade of the Marionette: Official First Trailer | First Look at Combat, Crafting & Weapon Upgrades

Shade of the Marionette: The Story of Piyorita is a story-driven 3D action RPG that combines stylish, accessible combat and fast, intuitive controls with crafting and a rich story set in the world of WitchSpring.

Follow Piyorita, a doll born without emotions or memories, as she ventures beyond the mirror on a journey to become a “Masterpiece.”

Coming to PC and consoles in the second half of 2027.

Wishlist now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5034390/
